name: n4_inventory_snapshot
description: Snapshot the inventory of a subtree to a local file, for n4_inventory_diff later (read-only on the station). One BOX load of base: every component down to depth levels below it (at most max_components, beyond it truncated) with its slot path, type, handle and recorded slots. By default the recorded slots are the configured properties: the simple and Status values directly on the component (a Status as 'value {status}'), leaving out runtime state so two snapshots of an unchanged station diff to empty. The type contract decides, not the slot type (a writable's fallback is recorded): left out are slots flagged transient on the instance or in the contract (a point's out, the inputs other than in1 and in8, a history extension's lastRecord and status), a Status out its contract does not declare as configuration, and inputs a link drives; a component below a transient slot is left out with everything below it. When the contracts cannot be read, notes says so and only instance flags, Status outs and linked inputs count. slots names the slots to record instead. The file is written under <state-dir>/exports/ with a name the server makes (inventory-<station>-<UTC time>.json, 0600, never overwritten); the reply gives name, path, components, bytes, truncated, base, depth and notes.

max_components.description: Most components recorded; beyond it the snapshot is truncated

slots.description: Slot names to record instead of the configured properties (e.g. ["facets", "out"])
